label: Fresh-clone pre-commit mirror gate cannot run: check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs loads a parser from untracked .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/shared/dist, and no install-time or documented step builds it, so any staged agent file hard-blocks with the misleading 'mirrors desync' message and a 're-sync the mirrors' remedy. Trigger requires staging an agent file, so it sits off the first-packet path.

Mirror content is hermetic at HEAD 82a71c87: check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs --all exits 0 over 11 agents, /doctor roster exits 0 across cursor/devin/opencode/codex/pi, and the Claude-only Explore fork is excluded from every gate; .opencode/agents is a tracked symlink to .skilled/agents and .cursor/.devin entries are tracked symlinks onto .claude files.

Local and CI paths diverge at the failure point: agent-mirror-sync.yml builds the shared parser before running the checker, pre-commit runs it bare; and of the crosswalk's three gates only the mirror checker is wired into pre-commit (pi/codex --check generators and roster check run only in CI).

Fix candidates for the ranked set: (a) document one spec-kit workspace build on the setup path (also closes runtime/dist session-start gaps); (b) make the mirror gate degrade honestly when the parser is absent (warn-skip like the node-missing branch, or print the build remedy); (c) reject tracking the built parser or inlining a second frontmatter parser on overengineering grounds.
pre-commit runs the mirror checker without the shared build primer that CI applies before the same checker.
Crosswalk section 5 claims the three mirror gates are wired into the pre-commit and CI paths; the pre-commit file runs two gates total and only one of them is a mirror gate.
A gate wired into pre-commit should be runnable after the documented setup, or degrade with an accurate, non-misleading message.
